verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented alert deduplication or grouping. When many incidents are created at once, each is still a separate incident, and the documented control is bulk-acknowledging them with a single tap to stop the phone ringing. That is an adjacent workflow convenience, not grouping related alerts into one incident that pages one human.

support.subject: As an SRE, duplicate and related alerts are deduplicated and grouped so one incident pages one human, not fifty

citations.quote: 30 incidents get created at the same time. Acknowledge them with a single tap and stop your phone from ringing.
10 incidents created at the same time? Acknowledge them with a single tap and keep your phone from ringing while fixing the issue.
